Central.reason: Central Line: Severe delays due to train cancellations, an earlier track fault at Epping and an earlier signal failure at Notting Hill Gate. London Buses, Elizabeth line, Chiltern Railway, Great Western Railway and Greater Anglia are accepting tickets via any reasonable route.

Circle.reason: Circle Line: Severe delays due to train cancellations.

Mildmay.reason: Mildmay Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations.

Piccadilly.reason: PICCADILLY LINE: Tuesday 25, Wednesday 26 and Thursday 27 August, no service between Cockfosters and Uxbridge. Trains will continue to operate between Acton Town and Heathrow. Use METROPOLITAN LINE services between Rayners Lane and Uxbridge and DISTRICT LINE trains between South Kensington and Ealing Common. Replacement buses operate.

Suffragette.reason: Suffragette Line: Severe delays due to an earlier points failure at Gospel Oak. London Underground is accepting tickets via reasonable routes.

Tram.reason: LONDON TRAMS: From Thursday 6 until Sunday 30 August, no service between Reeves Corner and East Croydon.
